name: Horizontal high-power pulsed test of dressed 1.3 GHz nine-cell SRF cavities at 2 K with calorimetric Q0 measurement
plain_name: Run a fully equipped accelerator cavity with high-power radio pulses at 2 K before it goes into a cryomodule
description: Dressed cavities (helium vessel, high-power input coupler, HOM couplers, magnetic shielding and tuner) are cooled to 2 K in a single-cavity horizontal test cryostat and driven by a klystron-based pulsed RF system; gradient, field emission and Q0 (from the heat dissipated to the helium bath, measured calorimetrically) are recorded, as at the Fermilab Horizontal Test Stand.
keywords: Run a fully equipped accelerator cavity with high-power radio pulses at 2 K before it goes into a cryomodule

sources.citation: Horizontal SRF Cavity Testing at Fermilab (Hocker, Harms, Lunin, Sukhanov, SRF2011, TUPO055)

requirements.rationale: Dressed cavities are operated at 2 K in the test cryostat.
Coupler conditioning and gradient runs use pulses up to 300 kW from the klystron system.
Nine-cell TESLA-style cavities resonate at 1.3 GHz.
Q0 is obtained calorimetrically from the heat dissipated into the helium bath.
The cryostat must connect the cavity's input coupler, HOM couplers and tuner to outside RF and controls.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
